displayName: GHADV-4524: Jenkins GitHub Plugin has an XSS vulnerability
description:

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_xss_ghadv_4524", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%jenkins%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%github%') AND "value" > 0
